touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Quatt qualifies as a local detour through Medieval cross in Quatt churchyard and CHURCH OF ST ANDREW. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Quatt: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Quatt offers Medieval cross in Quatt churchyard, CHURCH OF ST ANDREW within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.
